why: Designed classifications for the completeness oracle (frontend/roslyn/OwnSharp.Oracle): each case's method lists its universe occurrences with the verdict the frozen taxonomy assigns, the carrier production must deliver, and, for a case that witnesses a classified finding, the exact RED the oracle must raise. Written by the generator from the design, never recorded from a run.

comp-ctor-params.why: composition: a constructor whose parameter is a params array, expanded form; one opaque slot at the params ordinal, the call relevant, call_kind object_creation

comp-delegate-named.why: composition: a delegate invocation with named, reordered arguments; the delegate's declared parameter names resolve the binding, callee stays null

comp-mayvalue-arm-user-cast.why: composition: one arm of a conditional is an explicit user-defined cast of the handle, the other arm is not a handle; the cast arm is excluded inside the may-value form

comp-mayvalue-arm-user-conversion.why: composition: a conditional whose whole value passes through op_Implicit at the parameter; an arm that reaches the callee only through a user-defined conversion is not a handle alternative (registry conversion_rules)

comp-named-transparent.why: composition: a named, reordered argument carrying a reference upcast; the declared ordinal is the parameter's, the fact is the unwrapped var

comp-nested-transparent-inner.why: composition: the inner call receives the handle through a reference upcast (captured there, unwrapped); the outer call receives the inner result (nested_call_result)

comp-orphan-direct.why: composition: a direct flow into a non-consuming callee and nothing else tracked; the legacy pass reads the pass as an escape, the fact rides in the orphan carrier

comp-parens-user-explicit.why: composition: parentheses around an explicit user-defined cast; the hidden call inside the cast expression is the edge that decides

comp-parens-user-implicit.why: composition: parentheses around a handle whose parameter type needs op_Implicit; the conversion wins over the transparent-looking syntax (§10.6.3)

ctorinit-named-transparent.why: call-like site: a constructor initializer with named, reordered arguments and a reference upcast on the handle; the target constructor's declared ordinals bind

ctorinit-nested-call.why: call-like site: a nested call inside a constructor initializer's argument; the inner call captures the handle, the initializer receives its result (nested_call_result)

ext-boxed-receiver.why: site form: a struct handle as the receiver of an extension method on object; the receiver conversion is boxing, so nothing of the handle reaches ordinal 0

ext-conditional-access.why: site form: a reduced extension method invoked through `?.` on the handle; the receiver still binds declared ordinal 0 (F-CONDITIONAL-RECEIVER, repaired in A2.2-4R3)

member-accessor.why: member kind: a property setter passing its `value` parameter; accessors are not BaseMethodDeclarationSyntax and are never visited (finding F-MEMBER)

member-expression-bodied.why: member kind: an expression-bodied method with an owned parameter; the legacy pass visits block bodies only, so neither carrier sees the call (finding F-MEMBER)

member-local-function.why: member kind: the call sits in a declared local function; the capture is a named non-call context of the method and the inner call is the known unobserved gap, counted, not RED

member-record.why: member kind: a method of a record; the legacy pass enumerates class declarations only (finding F-MEMBER)

member-struct.why: member kind: a method of a struct; the legacy pass enumerates class declarations only (finding F-MEMBER)

shadow-lambda-local.why: shadowing witness: a handle created inside a lambda shares its spelling with a string local of the method; the string is not a candidate of anything, so no fact exists and no carrier holds the method (F-SHADOW, repaired in A2.2-4R1)

shadow-owner-form.why: shadowing witness (the GO's literal form): `Stream r = ...; { Stream r2 = ...; Sink(r2); }`; the non-candidate r2 is captured by nobody and the candidate r is captured by symbol

shadow-sibling-scopes.why: shadowing witness: two locals spelled `r` in sibling scopes; only the first is a candidate. A handle set keyed by spelling captured the second call too (F-SHADOW, repaired in A2.2-4R1: the sidecar binds by symbol)

shadow-sibling-scopes-reversed.why: shadowing witness: the non-candidate `r` comes first, the candidate second; order must not matter to a symbol-bound reading (F-SHADOW, repaired in A2.2-4R1)

vocab-constructor-initializer.why: call-like site: an owned constructor parameter forwarded through `: base(...)`, a really invoked constructor's declared ordinal 0 (ruled a fact shape in A2.2-4R4, landed in A2.2-4R5: call_kind constructor_initializer)

vocab-indexer-argument.why: vocabulary edge: the handle is the index of an element access, an argument of an indexer accessor's call that the vocabulary deliberately leaves out; the A2.2-4R4 ruling names it indexer_argument

vocab-interpolation-hole.why: vocabulary edge: the handle is an interpolation hole and the string is the argument; the A2.2-4R4 ruling names it interpolation_hole

vocab-tested-operand.why: vocabulary edge: the handle is compared and the boolean is the argument; the A2.2-4R4 ruling names it predicate_result
